entry.title: πRemote 0.1.0
entry.summary: # Windows 0.1.1 — FIND - Add FIND beside the IP field without changing the compact panel size. - Discover MPC/Force devices on the local network using existing trusted WSL SSH keys. - Fill the discovered IP, or choose a device when several are found; CONNECT remains separate. - No automatic connection, addin activation or MPC restart during discovery. - User-confirmed on the real network; discovery trust/bounds tests and native Windows connection regression pass. **Windows update only.
